otros.intro_html: Our speciality is INDIBA Radiofrequency. We also offer Ultherapy HIFU, Botox and fillers, Dermapen, Platinum Facial Cleanse, Wood Therapy and Pressotherapy. If you come for any of these, you'll receive the same expert care — but if you could only choose one, we'd say INDIBA Radiofrequency.

c1.p_html: We carry 35 years of Argentinian skincare heritage into every session — the same exacting standards, now in Benidorm.

c2.p_html: INDIBA Radiofrequency & Ultherapy HIFU equipment. Safety and efficacy backed by science.

c3.p_html: Every treatment is tailored to your individual needs, goals and skin type. No generic protocols.

c4.p_html: five-star Google reviews speak for themselves. If you're not satisfied, we'll find a solution together.

legado.label: Our story
legado.h2_html:
35 years of expertise.
A clinic faithful to that legacy.
legado.p1_html: This clinic opened in 2018, built on 35 years of expertise from an Argentinian aesthetician who understood something essential: skin isn't to be mistreated — it's to be listened to. We still work that way today.
legado.p2_html: We don't oversell sessions. We don't treat what you don't need. If your skin doesn't need INDIBA Radiofrequency, we'll tell you.
legado.p3_html: Every person is unique, and every skin has its own needs. That's why we don't apply cookie-cutter protocols: we talk with you, assess your skin, and design a plan tailored to you.
legado.eqLabel: The person behind the clinic today
legado.imgAlt: Gogna Kumar — Director of AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic
legado.bio1: I took on the leadership of AnyLopez to keep the standard of care that defines this clinic alive — right here in Benidorm, with the same skilled hands and the same technology.
legado.bio2_html: I won't sell you more sessions than your skin actually needs. I won't start a treatment without a proper assessment. If you have questions before you begin, message me directly on the clinic's WhatsApp — I'd rather lose a sale than have you start without all your questions answered.

items.a_html: Not at all. INDIBA radiofrequency is completely painless. Many clients describe it as a pleasant, warming sensation. It's suitable for all skin types, including the most sensitive.

items.q_html: How many sessions will I need?
items.a_html: It depends on the treatment and your goal. We typically recommend between 6 and 10 sessions for optimal results. During your free consultation, we'll design a personalised plan for you.

items.q_html: What if it doesn't work for me, like at other clinics?
items.a_html: We understand — investing without seeing results is a real disappointment. That's why we work with a guarantee: if you finish your 10-session INDIBA Radiofrequency Pack and see no improvement, session 11 is on us. Before starting, we assess your skin with no commitment, and if we don't think it's the right treatment for you, we'll tell you. We'd rather lose a sale than have you walk away disappointed again.

items.q_html: Why AnyLopez and not a cheaper clinic or a bigger franchise?
items.a_html: At a franchise, treatment is delivered in series — the same protocol for everyone. Here we carry 35 years of skincare expertise and design every session around your skin: INDIBA Radiofrequency with specific parameters, calibrated timing, session-by-session monitoring. When a cheaper clinic cuts price, they usually cut session length or device intensity. We do the opposite: 10 real 30-minute sessions at the power your skin actually needs — not one less.

items.q_html: Is it safe? Are there any contraindications?
items.a_html: INDIBA radiofrequency is approved for aesthetic and medical use, non-invasive, and requires no anaesthesia or recovery. Absolute contraindications are few: pregnancy, pacemakers or electronic implants, metal prostheses in the treatment area, active oncological conditions, and thrombosis. During your initial consultation we review your medical history; if anything rules out the treatment, we'll tell you before charging you anything.

items.q_html: When will I see real results? Aren't you just selling hype?
items.a_html: Honestly: you'll notice more hydrated, radiant skin from the 1st or 2nd session — the immediate effect of deep heat. The firming effect settles between sessions 5 and 8, when collagen reorganises. The consolidated result shows after all 10 sessions, with progressive improvement for another 3 to 6 months as your skin keeps regenerating. If anyone promises faster than that, they're selling hype.
Results vary by treatment and home skincare routine, but generally last between 6 and 12 months. With periodic maintenance sessions, results can become long-lasting.

items.q_html: From what age can I be treated?
items.a_html: From 18 years of age. For those under 18, parental or guardian authorisation and presence at the initial consultation is required.

items.q_html: Do I need to book in advance?
items.a_html: Yes, we work exclusively by appointment to ensure every client receives the personalised attention they deserve. You can book by phone, WhatsApp, or via the contact form.
